blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Our results show that contrastive learning outperforms a classification-based approach to authorship verification under the tested settings. We identify loss function, batch size, training duration, pre-trained model, input context length, and random text span data augmentation as important factors of model performance. Based on these considerations, we develop a ModernBERT Bi-Encoder model that achieves 98.4% accuracy on the PAN21 authorship verification task.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,对比性学习的成绩超过了在所测试的环境下进行作者资格核查的分类方法。 我们确定损失功能、批量规模、培训期限、预先训练的模型、输入上下文长度和随机文字跨度数据扩充是模型性能的重要因素。 基于这些考虑,我们开发了ModernBERT双编码器模型,在PAN21作者身份验证任务上实现了98.4%的准确度.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: How should authorship verification models be trained? As a task that asks whether two texts are by the same author [ 22 ] , it can easily be approached as a binary classification problem. When used for classification, transformer models can be trained as cross-encoders that use attention between two texts, while contrastive models such as bi-encoders [ 14 ] learn representations by training on many pairwise comparisons efficiently. Both approaches have a plausible story for why they might perform better than the other.
blocks.zh: 如何培训作者核查模型? 作为询问两个文本是否由同一个作者[22]的任务,可以很容易地作为二进制分类问题处理. 在用于分类时,变压器模型可以被训练成使用两个文本之间注意的交叉编码器,而对比模型如双编码器[14]则通过对许多对等比较的有效训练来学习表示. 这两种方法都有一个合理的故事,说明为什么它们的表现可能比其他方法更好。

blocks.en: PAN20 [ 17 ] provided a large authorship verification dataset based on fanfiction stories, and PAN21 [ 18 ] involved an open-set problem of testing on unseen authors and unseen fandoms. This setting continues to appear in work on datasets for evaluation of authorship verification systems [ 4 , 34 , 36 ] , and studies continue to report results on PAN21 [ 23 , 24 , 28 ] . It is accordingly useful for a comparison to prior work on the authorship verification task.
blocks.zh: PAN20 [17] 提供了基于扇形故事的大型作者验证数据集,PAN21 [18] 涉及一个开放的设定问题,即对看不见的作者和看不见的幻想进行测试. 这一设定继续出现在关于作者资格核查制度评价数据集的工作[4、34、36]中,研究报告继续报告关于PAN21[23、24、28]的结果。 因此,与以前关于作者身份核查任务的工作进行比较是有益的。

blocks.en: While transformer models are effective at authorship verification, it is less clear which fine-tuning choices are responsible for their performance. In the PAN21 fanfiction setting, Tyo et al. [ 37 ] fine-tuned BERT with pairwise contrastive loss, while Peng et al. [ 29 ] showed improved performance with a classification approach that averaged BERT representations from paired snippets to work around BERT’s limited context length. Nguyen et al. [ 28 ] later achieved competitive PAN21 results with binary classification using BigBird [ 45 ] , a longer-context transformer. Yet the top overall PAN21 system from Boenninghoff et al. [ 3 , 18 ] had a contrastive loss objective and used a bidirectional LSTM with attention [ 2 ] . Prior results point to the importance of input context length for PAN21. It still remains unclear whether binary classification or contrastive learning would be more effective when other factors are controlled, such as the pretrained model and input context length.
blocks.zh: 虽然变压器模型在作者身份验证中是有效的,但不太清楚的是,哪个微调选择对其性能负责. 在PAN21的粉丝设定中,Tyo et al. [37] 微调的BERT带有双向对比性损失,而Peng 等人. [29] 显示业绩有所改善,采用分类方法,将BERT的表示从配对片段平均到BERT有限的上下文长度。 阮等译. [28] 后来通过使用BigBird[45]的二进制分类,实现了具有竞争力的PAN21结果,这是一个较长的文本变压器. 然而,来自Boenninghoff等人的顶级PAN21系统。 [3, 18]具有对比性损失目标,并使用双向LSTM,注意[2]. 先前的结果显示,投入语境长度对于PAN21很重要. 仍然不清楚的是,当其他因素得到控制时,例如预先训练的模型和输入上下文长度,二进制分类或对比性学习是否更加有效。

blocks.en: Li et al. [ 23 ] clarify several design choices in this context, including the importance of fine-tuning, the benefit of cased tokenization, and the effectiveness of cosine distance when applied after mean pooling. However, the choice of training objective was explicitly left to future work, including whether contrastive learning shows improvement over a standard classification objective.
blocks.zh: 李等编. [23] 澄清这方面的若干设计选择,包括微调的重要性、用例标注的好处以及在平均集合后应用的余弦距离的有效性。 然而,培训目标的选择明确留给今后的工作,包括对比性学习是否比标准分类目标有所改进。

blocks.en: Our main contribution is a comparison of contrastive and classification-based training for transformer-based authorship verification. We tune batch size and learning rate separately for each approach, while holding the remaining training conditions fixed to support a meaningful comparison. We perform this comparison across several model architectures, as shown in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献是对基于变压器的作者身份核查进行对比和分类培训。 我们为每种方法分别调整批量规模和学习率,同时确定其余的培训条件,以支持有意义的比较。 如表1所示,我们在几个示范建筑中进行了这一比较。

blocks.en: Table 1: Transformer Model Size Summary
blocks.zh: 表1:变形器模型大小摘要

blocks.en: We also identify some of the practical choices that matter on this task. Various contrastive loss functions are considered. We further explore the impact of data augmentation, model choice, training duration, and input context length in the PAN21 authorship verification setting. We release the code and the dataset in Parquet format, including the validation data split used, at https://github.com/petekirby/contrastive-av to support future research.
blocks.zh: 我们还确定了对这项任务至关重要的一些实际选择。 考虑了各种对比性损失功能。 我们进一步探讨数据扩充、模型选择、培训期限以及PAN21作者身份验证设置中输入上下文长度的影响。 我们在https://github.com/petekirby/contrastive-av上发布了Parquet格式的代码和数据集,包括所使用的验证数据分解,以支持未来的研究。

blocks.en: 2 Methodology
blocks.zh: 2. 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Data Augmentation
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 数据增强

blocks.en: “The best way to make a machine learning model generalize better is to train it on more data.” [ 13 , p. 240] Following Boenninghoff et al. [ 3 ] , we convert the training data from fixed pairs into individual document rows with author IDs for dynamic pair recombination, yielding varied same-author and different-author pairs, with billions of potential distinct negative pairs. We use PyTorch Metric Learning [ 27 ] to sample authors randomly, each time randomly selecting two document samples per author. Each document sample is rotated to start at a random word boundary before truncation by the tokenizer. The goal was to retain fine details for this task, but a recent study [ 12 ] suggests a general advantage for text cropping over SimCSE-style dropout [ 10 ] . Random text rotation as a data augmentation technique allows equal length truncated spans at any position with little disturbance to the data. This can create thousands of distinct views for one sample and millions of distinct pairs of strings for a pair of samples.
blocks.zh: “使机器学习模式更普遍化的最好办法是对它进行更多的数据培训。” 继Boenninghoff 等人[3]之后,我们把从固定对子的训练数据转换成单个文件行,并配有作者ID进行动态对子重组,产生不同的同作者和不同作者对子,其中可能有数十亿个不同的负对子. 我们用PyTorch Metric Learning [27] 随机抽取作者,每次随机选择每个作者的两个文件样本. 每个文档样本被旋转到一个随机的单词边界开始,然后由指示器切换. 目标是为这项任务保留细微的细节,但最近的一项研究[12]表明,文本裁剪比SimCSE式的退出[10]具有普遍优势。 随机文字旋转作为一种数据增强技术,可以在任何位置上允许相同的长度截断间距,对数据几乎没有扰动. 这可以为一个样本创造上千个截然不同的视图,为一对样本创造上百万个截然不同的对弦.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Comparison of our two training approaches. Contrastive learning embeds each text independently and compares the resulting embeddings by cosine similarity. Pair classification concatenates both texts into one input sequence, allowing the transformer encoder to use attention across the two texts.
blocks.zh: 图1:我们两种培训方法的比较。 对比性学习将每个文本独立嵌入,并以余弦相似性来比较由此产生的嵌入. 平面分类将两种文本组合成一个输入序列,使变压器编码器在两种文本之间使用注意力.

blocks.en: 2.2 Pair Classification
blocks.zh: 2.2 对等分类

blocks.en: We fine-tune a transformer model for sequence classification, including weights for the projection head included with the model. The cross-encoder concatenates two truncated tokenized texts as a single input. Each document has one positive pair and a negative, different-author pair selected from the batch at random. A learning rate multiple of 5 is used for the projection head [ 6 , 16 ] . For prediction, the sigmoid output threshold that maximizes F1 on the validation set is used.
blocks.zh: 我们微调了用于序列分类的变压器模型,包括包含在模型中的投影头的重量. 交叉编码器将两个短写符号化的文本作为单一输入. 每个文档都有一对正对和一个从批量中随机选择的负,不同的作者对. 投影头使用5倍的学习率[6,16]. 在预测时,使用在验证集上最大化F1的sigmoid输出阈值.

blocks.en: 2.3 Contrastive Learning
blocks.zh: 2.3 矛盾学习

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 1 , a bi-encoder architecture [ 14 , 32 ] encodes one embedding per document with the same model. Each sample in a batch has one positive pair. Negative pairs include all samples by different authors in a batch. InfoNCE loss [ 38 , 42 ] with temperature scaling [ 5 ] is used to emphasize harder examples. This can be interpreted as a form of cross-entropy loss with temperature encouraging low similarity for negative pairs and high similarity for positive pairs, maximizing a lower bound on mutual information [ 38 ] for same-class embeddings. It’s equivalent to the NT-Xent loss [ 5 ] or Supervised Contrastive Loss [ 19 ] with one positive pair. We use a SupCon implementation [ 27 ] . This is the loss for anchor i i , positive j + j^{+} , batch negatives j − ∈ 𝒩 i j^{-}\in\mathcal{N}_{i} , and temperature τ \tau . The configuration used applies mean pooling over the final hidden states and doesn’t use a projection head. For prediction, we select the cosine similarity threshold that maximizes F1 on the validation set.

blocks.en: 2.4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 2.4 实验

blocks.en: The validation set uses 10,000 same-author, different-fandom pairs and 10,000 different-author pairs with authors and fandoms removed from training data. Model selection, hyperparameters, and calibration use only the validation set.
blocks.zh: 验证集使用10,000对同作者,不同fandom配对和10,000对不同作者配对,从培训数据中删除了作者和粉丝配对. 模型选择,超参数,校准只使用验证集.

blocks.en: A batch size and learning rate are selected for each approach by grid search on validation F1. We use a form of μ \mu Transfer [ 44 ] where hyperparameters tuned on the smallest model, TinyBERT, are transferred to larger models. For transfer across depth, Complete(d)P [ 25 ] with α = 1 \alpha=1 justifies no adjustment for depth. In practice, we adjust only learning rate based on the change in width. This involves an adjustment factor of 0.4 going from width 312 (TinyBERT) to width 768 (for DistilBERT, BERT, and ModernBERT-base) and an adjustment factor of 0.3 going from width 312 (TinyBERT) to width 1024 (ModernBERT-large).
blocks.zh: 通过在验证F1上的网格搜索,为每种方法选择批量大小和学习率. 我们使用一种 μ\mu 传输 [44] 的形式,其中超参数调制最小的模型,TinyBERT,被转移到更大的模型. 对于跨越深度的转移,用 α = 1\ alpha=1 的 complete(d)P [25] 表示不作深度调整的理由。 在实践中,我们只根据宽度的变化来调整学习率. 这涉及从宽312(TinyBERT)到宽768(DistilBERT,BERT,和ModernBERT-base)的0.4调整系数,以及从宽312(TinyBERT)到宽1024(ModernBERT-group)的0.3调整系数.

blocks.en: For simplicity not all hyperparameters are tuned [ 11 ] , and we don’t transfer weight decay, β 1 \beta_{1} , β 2 \beta_{2} , and ϵ \epsilon for AdamW but instead use recommendations or defaults from papers or code for each model. We don’t apply weight decay to biases or layer normalization [ 7 ] . We use linear decay [ 1 ] and 10% warmup.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,并非所有超参数都调制 [11] , 我们不转移重量衰减, β 1\beta_{1} β 2\beta_{2} 和\\ epsilon为 AdamW 调制, 我们不把重量衰减用于偏差或层层正常化[7]。 我们使用线性衰变[1]和10%的热量.

blocks.en: After fine-tuning for 10 epochs, both 256 and 512 context length results for contrastive models are shown in comparison to 512-length classification.
blocks.zh: 在对10个纪元进行微调后,对比模型的256和512上下文长度结果与512长的分类比较显示.

blocks.en: One model trained for 40 epochs, with Platt scaling and an abstention delta selected on the validation set, is used to report the full set of PAN21 test metrics.
blocks.zh: 一个为40个纪元训练的模型,在验证集中选择了普拉特缩放和一个弃权三角洲,用来报告全套的PAN21测试度量衡.

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Loss Function
blocks.zh: 3.1 函数损失

blocks.en: Table 2: TinyBERT contrastive, untuned batch size 256, untuned learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 \smash{2\times 10^{-5}} , PyTorch Metric Learning loss function defaults, 10 epochs.
blocks.zh: 表2:TinyBERT对比性,未调试的批量大小256,未调试的学习率2×10−5\smash{2\times 10×5},PyTorch Metric学习功能损失默认,10个纪元.

blocks.en: The loss functions listed in Table 2 are surveyed by Musgrave et al. [ 26 ] . InfoNCE loss has often been applied to larger datasets such as ImageNet [ 5 ] and Wikipedia [ 10 ] . It has been extended to emphasize harder instances [ 42 ] , include multiple positives [ 5 , 19 ] , and function practically at larger batch sizes [ 9 ] . It also has theoretical interpretations [ 38 , 30 ] . Pairwise contrastive loss has sometimes been applied to authorship verification [ 2 , 37 ] . A pairwise contrastive loss, semi-hard contrastive [ 43 ] , performed worse than losses that can consider all negatives in a batch such as InfoNCE, Circle [ 35 ] , and Multi-Similarity [ 39 ] . SoftTriple [ 31 ] and Proxy Anchor [ 20 ] , based on learning proxy embeddings per class, fail in this setting with 238,815 author classes in the training set used.
blocks.zh: 表2所列损失功能由Musgrave等人调查。 [26]. InfoNCE损失经常被应用于更大的数据集,如ImageNet[5]和维基百科[10]. 它被扩展为强调更难的例子[42],包括多种正数[5,19],实际上在较大的批量尺寸[9]。 它还有理论解释[38,30]. 对比性损失有时被用于作者资格核查[2,37]. 成对的对比性损失,半硬对比性[43],表现的比损失更差,在一批中,如InfoNCE, Circle [35],和多类似性[39]. SoftTriple [31]和Proxy Anchor [20],基于每个班级的学习代理嵌入,在此设置中失败,在所使用的训练集中,有238,815个作者课.

blocks.en: 3.2 Model Comparison
blocks.zh: 3.2 模型比较

blocks.en: Table 3: Length 512, epoch 10, tuned models. Batch size 8, learning rate 4 × 10 − 5 \smash{4\times 10^{-5}} for TinyBERT classification. Batch size 512, learning rate 4 × 10 − 4 \smash{4\times 10^{-4}} for TinyBERT contrastive. Learning rate factor 0.3 for ModernBERT-large and 0.4 for other models.
blocks.zh: 表3:长度512,第10期,调制模型. 批量大小 8, 学习率 4 × 10 − 5\ smash{4\times 10 + 5 + == 属于 TinyBERT 分类. 批量大小 512, 学习率 4× 10 − 4\ smash{4\times 10× 4} 对于 TinyBERT 对比性. ModernBERT的学习率系数为0.3,其他模型为0.4。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 , contrastive learning outperformed even when limited to 256-token-length input context, while using less computation than 512-token-length classification. ModernBERT’s classification performance could possibly be related to dropping the next sentence prediction task during pre-training.
blocks.zh: 如表3所示,对比性学习即使限于256个托肯长度的输入上下文,但使用少于512个托肯长度的分类的计算,其表现也优于此. 现代 BERT的分类性能可能与在培训前放弃下一句预测任务有关。

blocks.en: 3.3 Mean Pooling and Data Augmentation
blocks.zh: 3.3 平均集合和数据增强

blocks.en: Table 4: TinyBERT contrastive, batch size 1024, learning rate 4 × 10 − 4 \smash{4\times 10^{-4}} , temperature 0.01, 40 epochs. The projection head here uses a residual, GELU, and LayerNorm.
blocks.zh: 表4:TinyBERT对比度,批量大小 1024,学习率 4× 10− 4\smash{4\times 10^{-4}},温度 0.01,40 epocts. 这里的投影头使用一个残基,GELU,和LetleNorm.

blocks.en: SimCSE [ 10 ] used mean first-last layer pooling; ablation in Table 4 shows better results here with the last layer only. This can be interpreted as forcing the model to use all the transformer layers and to use transformers directly for the representation with respect to every token. Longer duration training performs better with TinyBERT and uses a larger tuned batch size. The performance drop and overfitting without random text spans show the effectiveness of the data augmentation.
blocks.zh: SimCSE [10] 使用了平均第一层集合;表4中的衰减显示这里只有最后一个层的较好结果. 这可以被解释为迫使模型使用所有变压器层,并且直接使用变压器来代表每个令牌. 与TinyBERT进行更长时间的培训,并使用更大的调制批量尺寸。 性能下降和过度适应而无随机文字跨度显示数据增强的有效性.

blocks.en: 3.4 Context Length and Batch Size
blocks.zh: 3.4 背景长度和批量大小

blocks.en: As shown in Table 5 , a context length of 1024 tokens instead of 512 increases performance. It’s left to future work to investigate whether longer context length effectively means that a larger batch size is supported by the additional data.
blocks.zh: 如表5所示,上下文长度为1024个令牌而不是512个令牌,提高了性能. 更长时间的上下文长度是否有效意味着更多数据支持更大的批量规模,这个问题留给今后的工作去研究。

blocks.en: Table 5: ModernBERT-large Bi-Encoder, learning rate 1.2 × 10 − 4 \smash{1.2\times 10^{-4}} , temperature 0.01, 40 epochs.
blocks.zh: 表5:现代BERT大双编码器,学习速率1.2×10−4\smash{1.2\times 10^{-4}},温度0.01,40 epocs.

blocks.en: Table 6: Comparison to prior work.
blocks.zh: 表6:与以前工作的比较。

blocks.en: 3.5 Comparison to Prior Work
blocks.zh: 3.5 与先前工作的比较

blocks.en: As shown in Table 6 , Peng et al.’s concatenated input BERT model with classification achieves F1 of 0.917 that exceeds the F1 of contrastive BERT at 0.881, which can be attributed to using more than only 512 tokens per text. The results with BigBird Cross-Encoder and Boenninghoff et al.’s bidirectional LSTM, neither of which are constrained by a 512-token context length, also show the value of longer context on the fanfiction data that has up to 21,000 characters per document. The 4096 token context length ModernBERT Bi-Encoder achieves state-of-the-art performance. Based on the earlier comparison between classification and contrastive learning approaches, it is plausible that some of this can be attributed to the use of contrastive learning. The context length, model choice, training duration, and data augmentation also contribute to the result.
blocks.zh: 如表6所示,彭等人用分类法的缩写输入BERT模型达到F1的0.917,超过对比BERT的F1的0.881,可归结为每文本使用超过512个令牌. BigBird Cross-Encoder和Boenninghoff等人双向LSTM的结果,两者都不受512个上下文长度的限制,也显示每个文档最多有21000个字符的扇形数据上较长上下文的价值. 4096令牌上下文长度 ModernBERT Bi-Encoder 实现了最先进的性能. 根据早先分类法和对比性学习方法的比较,可以认为,其中一些可以归因于使用对比性学习。 内容长度、模式选择、培训期限和数据扩充也有助于取得结果。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Echoing earlier similarity-based feature engineering with many negatives [ 21 ] , our results support similarity-based deep learning with many negatives. This outperformed the classification-based approach, but it is left to future work to consider performance on authorship attribution, style change detection, and other datasets. The results suggest that learning useful representations for authorial style can be done efficiently on each text independently. Computational advantages from delaying pairwise comparison until the cosine similarity metric used as part of the loss function appear to outweigh any benefits of attention across every pair. This method benefits from large batch sizes that have many negative instances. The contrastive learning objective for open-set authorship verification works as if solving many implicit authorship attribution proxy tasks. The interpretation here follows the view of InfoNCE [ 38 ] as a categorical cross-entropy objective over one positive and many negative samples, where the model is trained to identify the positive example among the batch candidates.
blocks.zh: 与早期的类似性特征工程相呼应,与许多负态[21],我们的结果支持基于相似性的深度学习与许多负态. 这超过了基于分类的方法,但留给今后的工作来考虑作者归属,风格变化检测,以及其他数据集的性能. 结果表明,可以独立地在每个文本上有效地学习作者风格的有用表述。 计算的好处是,推迟对偶比较,直到作为损失函数一部分的余弦相似度测量值似乎超过每对对子注意的任何好处。 这种方法得益于大批量规模,这种规模有许多负面情况。 开放设置作者身份验证的对比性学习目标,似乎解决了许多隐含作者身份归属代理任务. 这里的解释遵循了InfoNCE[38]的观点,即对于一个正面和许多负面的样本,一个绝对的交叉目标,在该样本中,对模型进行了培训,以确定批次候选人中的正面例子。
